summary: Plains All American Pipeline L.P. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $2.7 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing existing credit agreements. The facility can be increased to $4.0 billion and permits Canadian subsidiary borrowings up to $1.0 billion equivalent. No special-situation event (M&A, tender, spin-off, restructuring, activist campaign) is present; the filing is a routine refinancing of debt facilities. A routine credit facility agreement is not a special situation. The filing is categorized as None.
